item.title: Gumloop lands $50M from Benchmark to turn every employee into an AI agent builder
item.description: Benchmark’s new patner Everett Randell, sees enterprise automation as the largest opportunity in AI.

item.title: Alexa+ gets a new ‘adults only’ personality option that curses but won’t get into NSFW content
item.description: The new Sassy style can curse and roast you, but the fun ends there.

item.title: Wonderful raises $150M Series B at $2B valuation
item.description: The funding round, led by Insight Partners, comes just four months after Wonderful raised a $100 million Series A.

item.title: Google is using old news reports and AI to predict flash floods
item.description: A new way to solve data scarcity: Turning qualitative reports into quantitative data with an LLM.

item.title: Google Maps is getting an AI ‘Ask Maps’ feature and upgraded ‘immersive’ navigation
item.description: The tech giant says the "Immersive Navigation" launch is the biggest update to Maps in over a decade.

item.title: AI ‘actor’ Tilly Norwood put out the worst song I’ve ever heard
item.description: This song is an AI actor's rallying cry to other AI actors, urging them to keep going despite the naysayers who doubt their humanity. Literally no one can relate to this.

item.title: Ford’s new AI assistant will help fleet owners know if seatbelts are being used
item.description: Ford Pro AI debuted at Work Truck Week in Indianapolis and is now available to all of its U.S.-based Pro telematics subscribers.

item.title: Zendesk acquires agentic customer service startup Forethought
item.description: Forethought was years ahead of its time and the 2018 winner of TechCrunch Battlefield.

item.title: Netflix may have paid $600 million for Ben Affleck’s AI startup
item.description: This deal could rank as among the streaming giant's largest acquisitions ever.

item.title: Lovable says it added $100M in revenue last month alone, with just 146 employees
item.description: Swedish vibe-coding unicorn Lovable crossed $400 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR) in February.

item.title: Replit snags $9B valuation 6 months after hitting $3B
item.description: Replit raised a new $400 million round and said it hopes to have $1B in ARR by year's end.

item.title: WordPress debuts a private workspace that runs in your browser via a new service, my.WordPress.net
item.description: WordPress’s new browser-based service lets users create private sites without hosting or signing up, turning the platform into a personal workspace for writing, research, and AI tools.

item.title: Rivian spin-out Mind Robotics raises $500M for industrial AI-powered robots
item.description: The startup, which was created by Rivian founder RJ Scaringe, is looking to train on data from, and deploy in, Rivian's factory.

item.title: Meta’s Moltbook deal points to a future built around AI agents
item.description: Meta’s Moltbook acquisition may look odd at first, but the deal could signal how Meta sees AI agents shaping future advertising and commerce on an agentic web.

item.title: Amazon expands a program that lets customers shop from other retailers’ sites
item.description: The changes allow more merchants to participate in Amazon's Shop Direct program, which sends Amazon customers to other retailers' websites.

item.title: Canopii looks to succeed where past indoor farms have not
item.description: Canopii's robotic farms can autonomously grow 40,000 pounds of herbs and leafy greens a year while being the size of a basketball court.

item.title: Google brings Gemini in Chrome to India
item.description: The rollout will let users access Gemini in Chrome through a sidebar on desktop, enabling them to ask Google's AI chatbot questions about the content on the screen; get information from their Gmail, Keep, Drive, and YouTube; and compare tab contents.

item.title: Amazon launches its healthcare AI assistant on its website and app
item.description: Health AI can answer questions, explain health records, manage prescription renewals, book appointments, and more.

item.title: AI-powered apps struggle with long-term retention, new report shows
item.description: AI can drive stronger early monetization for apps, but sustaining value remains the challenge, RevenueCat's latest report finds.

item.title: ChatGPT can now create interactive visuals to help you understand math and science concepts
item.description: Instead of just reading an explanation or looking at a static diagram, users can now engage directly with interactive visuals.
